what: A semi-modular mono synth: VCO, self-oscillating 4-pole ladder filter, LFO, ADSR, VCA, wave folder, S+H, mixer and a patchbay with normals and dummy plugs. Four tracks on their own MIDI channels, MIDI clock sync, arpeggiator, chorus, delay and reverb, 90 sounds. Made for blind players too: a screen reader says every page, knob and message, in the FM-1's own voice or through FM-1 Screen Reader on a computer.
author: wootrop & gpix
